$comment: Shared test vectors for the experiment Target URL rule ($mp.target version 1).
Every implementation of the Target URL matcher runs against every case.
Hash routes are compared decoded; rule routes are stored as typed.
Hash routes, on the page and in the rule, drop one leading ! and then one trailing / (a route that is exactly / keeps it); no leading / is added, so #reviews has route reviews.
Source of truth: this file is the canonical copy of these vectors.
